description: City of Boston Managed Streets is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Boston Maps. This layer represents all the public and many of the private roadways in Massachusetts, including designations for Interstate, U.S. and State routes. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Boston Maps. Its tags are Interstate, MassDOT, expressway, highway, roads. It offers 8 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2024-12-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
